unsupported: Fine Wood Works is a family-owned cabinet shop based in Piedmont, Missouri. Founded in 2006 by Lucas and Sara Edgy, the business traces its roots to Lucas’s college years when he built bookcases and small cabinets for friends. By 2003 he was working full-time as a cabinetmaker in Piedmont, and two years later the couple opened Fine Wood Works. In 2006 they purchased 30 acres with a barn, which they remodeled into the current woodworking facility.
